message.content:
I can help you figure out whether your car will make it.  
To do that I’ll need a couple of quick details:

1. **How many gallons (or liters) of fuel are left in your tank?**  
2. **What’s the fuel tank’s total capacity?** (If you’re not sure, most passenger cars hold around 12–15 gal, but some larger vehicles can hold up to 50 gal.)

Once I have that, I can estimate the remaining range and compare it to the ~750 mi trip from Rivermist to Stonebrook. Let me know the numbers and we’ll crunch the math!
